How to read this table

  • Reviewed means the full written review is live — watch the video when one exists. Review coming means the written review is not published yet. We never claim hands-on testing we haven't done.
  • — means that figure is not verified. It is left blank on purpose rather than guessed.
  • Out of stock means the listing showed no stock when checked (Nov 18, 19, 20, 21, or 22, 2026) — the shop link still goes to the live listing.
  • Walmart titles the Jackery listing "Jackery E1000AC Sand Gold 1060Wh" — the unit photo and reviews confirm it is the Explorer 1000 v2.
  • Prices checked Nov 18–22, 2026 and can change. Full sources for every figure are in the site build notes.
